title: FleetAgentOfflinePayload
description: Payload of `fleet.agent.offline` version 1: an agent went offline, by signing off or by not reporting for too long. The envelope's `partner_id` is set to the partner the agent is attached to. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner whose service the agent is attached to, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

last_seen_at.description: When the agent was last heard from before it went offline, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
